scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run prepare:ocr-assets && electron-vite build
scripts.build:distribution: npm run typecheck && npm run prepare:ocr-assets && electron-vite build --mode dfragon-distribution
scripts.build:win:portable: npm run build:distribution && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:development: npm run typecheck && npm run prepare:ocr-assets && electron-vite build --mode dfragon-development
scripts.build:test: npm run typecheck && npm run prepare:ocr-assets && electron-vite build --mode dfragon-test
scripts.build:win:test:portable: npm run build:test && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --config electron-builder.test-channel.ts --publish never
scripts.build:win:development: npm run build:development && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.development.ts --publish never
scripts.build:mac: npm run prepare:ocr-assets && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:linux: npm run prepare:ocr-assets && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.mvp:build: npm run typecheck && npm run prepare:ocr-assets && electron-vite build --mode mvp-preview
scripts.dev:app: npm run prepare:ocr-assets && install-electron && node --env-file-if-exists=.env ./node_modules/electron-vite/bin/electron-vite.js dev
